reason: The cited code reads stored browser network requests and returns request details, headers, and response bodies via addResult, and can also save a response body to a client output file. That supports SECRET because network headers/bodies can include authenticated or otherwise non-public browser data. It supports UNTRUSTED because response bodies/headers are supplied by remote sites and are attacker-controllable. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; writing a response body to a local resolved output file is not, by itself, a SINK under the given definition.
